description: The Capsule Corp ship: a big round white ship with a black cap and a wide black band, a sphere on four short legs with flat plates and round feet, a door hole at the front left and a ramp from the door down to the ground.
layout: Middle: a round white hull, a sphere 3 wide (x -1.5 to 1.5, z -1.5 to 1.5), standing on four legs with no stone base. Its widest line is 1.19 above the ground; its top half is a full half-sphere (top at 2.69); its bottom half is shorter (1.13 high), so it narrows to a small bottom 0.06 above the ground. Under it, a flat round pad 0.7 wide and 0.1 high lies on the ground; the bottom tip of the hull sinks 0.04 into it. Legs: four, 90 degrees apart, at the front (turned 20 degrees to the left), the right, the back, and the left. Each is a flat white plate 0.32 wide and 0.08 thick that comes straight out of the hull at 0.56 high, from 0.9 (inside the hull, which is 1.25 wide there in radius) to 1.68 from the axis; a blue-grey column 0.18 wide under its outer end, 1.5 from the axis; and a round white foot 0.34 wide and 0.08 high on the ground. Front left: the door is only a hole in the hull, nothing comes out: its axis is turned 38 degrees to the left of the front, its bottom edge 0.75 high. The ramp: one flat white plate 0.6 wide, straight along the door axis, from the hull under the door hole (0.75 high; its top end starts 1.3 from the axis, just inside the hull, which is 1.38 in radius there) down to the ground 2.1 from the axis (its low end near x -1.29, z 1.65), a 41.19 degree slope. It passes left of the front leg and above its plate (the plate is 0.56 high and ends at 1.68). Colors: the hull is white with a black cap on top (from 2.4 high) and a wide black band from the widest line down to 0.53 high. The bottom half of the hull is black; the cap and the white bottom are copies of the hull halves with the same curve, 1 to 2 cm narrower and taller, so they come out of the hull only beyond one ring of its facets and follow it exactly: no step, nothing sticks out. The plates, the feet, and the pad are white; the columns are blue-grey; the ramp is light grey. The CAPSULE CORP. letters, the round blue portholes, the door opening, the steps on the ramp, and the thin blue struts under the hull are not shapes: they will be painted in textures or left out.
